name: 21050 · Forest Hill, MD
findings: ZIP 21050 (Forest Hill) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21050 (Forest Hill) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
